item.title: The Coin Game launches in early 2026 for PS5, Xbox Series, and PC
item.description: Open-world arcade adventure game The Coin Game will leave Early Access and launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, and PC via Steam in early 2026, publisher Kwalee and developer devotid announced.

item.title: GRIME II demo now available
item.description: A demo for Metroidvania / action adventure game sequel GRIME II is now available for PC via Steam, publisher Kwalee and developer Clover Bite announced.

item.title: Co-op dark fantasy looter shooter Vision Quench announced for PC
item.description: Pocketpair Publishing and developer WizMUD Games have announced co-op dark fantasy looter shooter Vision Quench for PC (Steam). It will launch in 2026.

item.description: Escape from Ever After will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Switch, and PC via Steam on January 23, 2026, publisher HypeTrain Digital and developer Sleepy Castle Stuâ¦

item.title: This Week’s Japanese Game Releases: Karous, Ripple Island: Kyle and Cal’s Restaurant, more
item.description: Karous for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Switch, and Ripple Island: Kyle and Cal’s Restaurant for Switch 2 and PC are the highlights of this week’s Japanese video game releases.

item.title: PIONER launches in Early Access on December 16
item.description: Open-world MMO first-person shooter PIONER will launch in Early Access for PC via Steam on December 16, developer GFA Games announced.

item.description: Publisher Dotemu and developer Tribute Games have released the opening animation for arcade-style beat ’em up game MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.
